【Global Map & Travel Services】
● Destination search and route planning are ready to use immediately;

● Offers congestion avoidance plans based on real-time traffic conditions; lane guidance while driving, enlarged views of complex intersections, and traffic light countdowns help you reach your destination faster.
● Ideal for group hiking and local fun: Supports location sharing with friends and intercom features during navigation, ensuring you never "lose contact."

● Compare prices before calling a ride to save money on taxis and travel effortlessly.
● Enjoy discounts for ride-hailing in both mainland China and Hong Kong.
● With a low rejection rate, you can call a ride anytime to start your journey.
● One-click payment supports automatic deductions, making rides more convenient.
【No Waiting for Buses or Subways: Arrival Alerts Included】
● Get real-time information on nearby buses and subways, including departure schedules, live location details, and arrival times;
● Within the Gaode App, you can view and navigate directly to designated subway or bus stops for boarding – simple and convenient.
【Cross-Border Travel: Food, Fun, and Leisure in Shenzhen】
● Seamless cross-border route planning.
● Hotel price comparison across the entire network, with 24/7 service assurance.
● Discounted ticket bookings for scenic spots: Buy instantly, use immediately, and enjoy no-reason refunds.
● Search for "Charging Map" / "Gas Stations" on Gaode to find nearby electric vehicle charging stations and fuel pumps: Plenty of options with strong cost-performance ratios.
